messages.text: I turned on reduced motion on my computer, but the cards and the win banner still animate. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Fixed reduced motion for the cards and win banner. Their animations are disabled when the system preference is on and update if the preference changes while the game is open. Normal animations remain in place otherwise.

Type checking, the build, all 138 unit tests, and seven Chromium motion and gameplay checks passed. The changed files pass formatting; the repository-wide formatting check reports issues in three unrelated files: `scripts/replay.test.ts`, `tests/accessibility.e2e.test.ts`, and `tests/layout.e2e.test.ts`.
